user.title: Tuya BLE Mesh
user.description: This build scans Tuya Bluetooth devices and reads the authenticated Tuya mobile-cloud device list so the exact device family and keys can be identified. Results are available to administrators at /api/tuya_ble_mesh/probe.

abort.already_configured: Tuya BLE Mesh is already configured.

scan.name: Scan for Tuya BLE devices
scan.description: Collect Bluetooth advertisements for the configured duration.

gatt.name: Dump GATT services
gatt.description: Connect once to a device and enumerate its GATT services and readable characteristics.

cloud_dump.name: Dump Tuya cloud devices
cloud_dump.description: Read the raw home and device payloads through the existing Tuya mobile session.

probe.name: Run full probe
probe.description: Scan Bluetooth, dump the Tuya cloud device list, and optionally inspect a GATT target.
